text: EducationalObjectives We foster the high level talents who can match the needs of our nation's modernization, who are familiar with the knowledge of modern economics, especially the basic theory of international economics, the rules and the laws of international trade, and the present situation of the development of the economy and trade in the world. They've also mastered the basic technique of international trade. After graduation, they will be of capabilities to serve in the companies or institutions which are relative to foreign trade. Educational Requirement Students must grasp the knowledge of modern economics, the basic theory of international economics, and the basic technique of international trade. They also must meet the requirement of the moral education and the physical education. A college student should obtain the knowledge and the abilities as following: 1. The modern economics, the basic theory and methods of international economics, the technique of international. 2. The statistics and accounting methods to do analysis and research work; trade; 3. The basic knowledge of international trade and the transportation in foreign trade; 4. The abilities in English listening, speaking, reading and writing; 5. The abilities in operating computers, data analysis and management. Length of School and Degree Duration: 4 years Degrees Conferred Bachelor of Economics
